findings.title: Round-58-fresh /tmp scratch litter during wave 2: tools honour TMPDIR but default to /tmp, keep trees on FAIL, and the lane's host guard cannot see it
findings.evidence: Six dirs created 2026-10-30 09:00–09:05 (round-58 wave-2 window; now ≈09:12): tameshi-r4-2-regression.{ZdfeTt,3gCWbo}, tameshi-r17-MeasureV2-{j47nm6kj,7ttebcrt}, tameshi-r16-CRMeasure-tc4hz053, tameshi-mte-regression-kzakrvon (mode 0700, all ten mutate-and-run.sh regression legs + regression.stdout). -newermt count after 09:03 = 0, so the runs had finished writing and the dirs were left behind. Cause chain [O in parts, I in the join]: tools/mutate-and-run.sh:1432 `root=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/tameshi-r4-2-regression.XXXXXX")`; :150-151 keeps the tree on FAIL/SETUP; tools/registry.json selftest rows contractually bless 'TMPDIR empty => unset, the platform default applies'. The only lane guard, .ufo/evidence/round-58/no-harm.sh:47-48 (r53-scratch-hygiene), greps SOURCE for `dir\s*=\s*["']/tmp` and never inspects the host /tmp, so source-clean + host-littering passes.
findings.impact: Recurring, invisible breach of the round's scratch discipline (/fast/scratch/hyaku or TMPDIR; /tmp only for <50 MB): every round re-litters /tmp the same way (116 accumulated entries, 597 MB, oldest 2026-10-27), a shared tmpfs also carrying browser/agent runtime state. A --regression FAIL leaves its evidence tree in /tmp indefinitely; 0700 on the regression root also hides its contents from non-root inspectors during incident triage.
findings.remediation_smallest: Wave-2 seats/dispatch: export TMPDIR under the seat's HYAKU_SCRATCH before running any lane tool. Cheap follow-up for the L1 to route: add a no-harm.sh arm that counts host /tmp/tameshi-* entries (RED if any newer than round start); operator-owned cleanup of the 597 MB (D7 precedent: cleanup is operator-owned and named in the report). No tool code change required — the tool contracts are internally consistent; the gap is seat environment + host-blind guard.
findings.inference_marks: Which seat/tool invocation created each fresh dir is INFERENCE from the dir names/fingerprints matching tools (mutate-and-run.sh --regression; r16 CRMeasure; r17 MeasureV2 selftests) — direct attribution not attempted to avoid touching live seats. Everything else above is observed output.

findings.title: Hyaku harness config backup with provider/plan entries sitting in /tmp since Oct 28 (0600)
findings.evidence: -rw------- 1 vgpnk vgpnk 16608 Oct 28 12:13:57 /tmp/hyaku-cfg-backup/config.yml.20261028T121435.bak. Redacted key-name scan shows provider/plan entries: xai-oauth/grok-4.5, xai-oauth/grok-4.7, xai-oauth/grok-4.7-build-fast, xai-oauth/grok-composer-2.5-fast, alibaba-token-plan/deepseek-v4.1-flash, alibaba-token-plan/qwen3.8-flash, alibaba-token-plan/qwen3.8-max, m_grok, m_grok45. Values were deliberately never read or printed (awk key-name-only extraction).
findings.impact: A harness config backup — plausibly carrying auth material for xai-oauth integrations [INFERENCE; values unread] — lives in a world-listable, volatile directory subject to tmp cleaners and to being swept into any broad /tmp collection. 0600 mitigates read access; placement, not perms, is the defect.
findings.remediation_smallest: Operator: move the backup out of /tmp (e.g. ~/.config/hyaku/backup/ or delete if superseded); stop creating config backups under /tmp.

findings.title: Wave-1 seat scratch retained past wave end (7 dirs, 2822 MB, still present at 09:04)
findings.evidence: T58W1ExecAssim 476M (mtime 08:34:04), T58W1ExecC2Reg 476M (08:36:14), T58W1Fix02 221M (08:33:28), T58W1Fix03 221M (08:34:24), T58W1Lab04/05/06 476M each (08:34:06/37/37) — all present at 09:04, >30 min after wave-1's last writes and while wave 2 runs. Discipline: each seat deletes its scratch before yielding.
findings.impact: ≈2.8 GB held past wave end; per-seat deletable, no cross-seat conflict (dirs are private).
findings.remediation_smallest: The named wave-1 seats delete their dirs on next contact, or the L1/operator sweeps them; wave-2 seats should keep the trap-rm discipline they are mostly meeting (scratch total fell 18G → 9.1G during this sweep).

clean_sweeps.name: round-58 instruments × hardcoded /tmp
clean_sweeps.command: grep tool, pattern '/tmp', over freeze.json, contract.json, no-harm.sh, controls.sh, deciding-run.sh, c1/{measure.py,panel.json,keys.json,defects.json}, c2/{measure.py,mutants.json}, control/{gen_ledger.py,gen_registry.py}
clean_sweeps.outcome: No hardcoded /tmp path in any instrument. Three legitimate non-path hits: no-harm.sh:47 (the guard's own search pattern), c2/measure.py:17 (docstring '/tmp is never named'), c1/defects.json (defect-row text quoting historical R52.5/R53.6).

notes: The lane's tool contracts are internally consistent: strict_scratch_root() (7 tools) hard-fails could-not-evaluate on a set-but-unusable TMPDIR and honours TMPDIR when set; mutate-and-run.sh honours TMPDIR. The defect is at the seam: nothing enforces TMPDIR export at seat level, and the only hygiene guard (no-harm.sh:47-48) is source-only, never host-inspecting. SENT02-1 is that seam, evidenced live during this round.

Registry selftest rows explicitly bless 'the platform default' when TMPDIR is unset — consistent with the tools, in tension with the round dispatch that mandates HYAKU_SCRATCH and /tmp only <50 MB. Worth a routed decision (SKILL/dispatch wording vs tool default) rather than a code fix.
kama-r64 scratch (61.4 GB) dwarfs everything else on /fast/scratch/hyaku (~85 GB total); it is a live lane (peer KamaR64 running) — monitored only, no judgment made.

Guard blind spot is the same class the lane has hit before: T58W1Panel07 receipt notes a census regex that required mkdir( with 'at' suffix and missed tempfile.mkdtemp — source-regex guards keep missing mkdtemp-shaped defaults.
Six of the 116 /tmp entries date from TODAY during wave 2; the remaining 110 (Oct 27–28) span rounds ≈53–57, confirming the pattern is per-round recurring, not a round-58 regression.
No tools were installed or upgraded this session (none needed); pacman untouched per the host-wide pause.
scratch_cleanup: This seat never created a HYAKU_SCRATCH dir (no /fast/scratch/hyaku/tameshi-r58/T58W2Sent02 exists) and wrote only its designated w2 outputs + receipts; nothing to delete. /tmp was never written by this seat.
